arms.a0: reuse the exact Step 5 frozen-model validation artifact
arms.grpo_identity: reuse the exact selected-domain Step 5 identity-GRPO training and validation artifacts
arms.grpo_oracle: deterministic evaluator utility in [0,1], evaluator-only fields never enter the actor prompt
arms.grpo_quality: DeepSeek sees task and candidate without any reference and judges correctness; apply the Step 4 selected transform to q
arms.prompt_imitation: reuse the exact Step 5 prompt-imitation validation artifact
arms.sft_teacher: one pinned greedy DeepSeek V4 Flash answer for each of the same 1000 unique training prompts; train independently from A0

checkpoint_selection: maximum global step after the fixed training budget; no early stopping, validation model selection, or intermediate checkpoint comparison
domains: exactly the two domains frozen by Step 6; CommonsenseQA is mandatory

grpo.start: same frozen A0 for every trainable arm; no SFT warm start
